text: The leaky integrator is derived by forward-Euler discretizing the rate model tau*x_dot = -x + W_rec f(x) + W_in u + b; the leak rate is defined as alpha = ___ (Euler step over membrane time constant).
explanation: Forward-Euler discretization of tau*x_dot = -x + ... with step size Delta t yields the leaky update with leak rate alpha = Delta t / tau, which must lie in (0, 1]. It is the ratio of the integration step to the membrane time constant tau.
